item.title: Upcoming plans help Murph stay relevant
item.summary: One morning check updates Journal and brings useful travel and life context into private conversations and reminders.
item.details: Active calendar and email connections participate without an extra setup step, while existing opt-outs remain respected. Useful dates, timezones, and logistics stay available while expired plans drop out. Journal updates and follow-ups remain, and your reminder schedules and experiment plans stay under your control.
